newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stock gains fizzle at close, eyeing Wall St.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stock gains fizzle at close, eyeing Wall St.

text.p: Madrid stocks ended flat on Monday, coming off intrasession highs as losses on Wall Street weighed on the indices, dealers said.
The general index rose 0.14 points, 0.03 percent, to 475.55 while the Ibex fell 2.47 points, 0.05 percent, to 5,447.29.

Telefonica ended down 15 pesetas to 3,380 in heavy volume accounted for mostly by trading. State holding firm SEPPa was expected to announce the maximum price for the retail share offering after the close.

Dealers said Thursday's January inflation data is likely to keep the bourse on hold this week. The Consumer Price Index is expected to show a year on year rise of 3.0 percent, after 3.2 percent in December, according to analysts.
Some are also expecting a rate cut at Friday's Bank of Spain repo if Thursday's inflation data appears to allow it.
